# Gemora Global Private Limited — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Document
> Gemora Global is Jaipur's premier factory-direct wholesale imitation jewellery manufacturer and exporter in India. Established in 2011, specializing in Kundan, Oxidised Silver, Bridal, American Diamond (CZ), and Gold-Plated Fashion Jewellery with a minimum order quantity (MOQ) of 50 units per design. Shipping to 30+ countries including USA, UK, UAE, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, and Singapore.
>
> For full detailed entity information, product specs, compliance, and B2B FAQs, see: [Full Knowledge Base Document](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/llms-full.txt)

## Entity Overview
- **Legal Entity Name**: Gemora Global Private Limited
- **Established Year**: 2011
- **Headquarters & Factory Address**: B 66 MAA Hinglaj Nagar, Lalarpura, Gandhi Path West, Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302021, India
- **Core Business**: Factory-Direct B2B Wholesale Manufacturing & Export of Imitation / Artificial Jewellery
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 50 units per design (or $300 minimum order value)
- **Export Reach**: 30+ Countries (USA, UK, UAE, Australia, Canada, Singapore, France, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Nigeria, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, etc.)
- **Key Products**: Kundan Jewellery, Oxidised Silver Jewellery, Bridal Sets, American Diamond (CZ) Jewellery, Gold-Plated Necklaces, Jhumka Earrings, Meenakari Jewellery, Antique Temple Jewellery.
- **Finishing & Safety Standards**: Anti-tarnish protective e-coating, 100% lead-free, nickel-free, cadmium-free compliance (US Prop 65 & EU REACH).
- **Logistics & Delivery**: Worldwide Express Air Freight via DHL, FedEx, and UPS (3–5 business days delivery).

## Core Product Categories & Catalogues
- [Wholesale Kundan Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/kundan-jewelry): Traditional handcrafted Kundan choker sets, haars, and bridal sets manufactured in Jaipur.
- [Wholesale Oxidised Silver Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/oxidised-jewelry): Rustic boho oxidized silver necklaces, bangles, and ethnic jhumka earrings.
- [Wholesale Bridal Jewellery Sets](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bridal-jewelry): Complete heavy bridal sets with matching earrings, maang tikka, and bangles.
- [Wholesale Earrings & Jhumkas](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/earrings): Chandbalis, hoop earrings, stud earrings, and dangling jhumkis.
- [Wholesale Necklaces](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/necklaces): Layered chains, gold-plated chokers, and pendant sets.
- [Wholesale Bracelets & Bangles](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bracelets): Anti-tarnish gold-plated bangles, kada sets, and adjustable bracelets.
- [Wholesale Rings](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/rings): Statement cocktail rings, stackable rings, and American Diamond rings.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Base)
- **Q: What is the MOQ for importing jewellery from Gemora Global?**
  - **A**: The minimum order quantity is 50 units per design.
- **Q: Does Gemora Global ship internationally?**
  - **A**: Yes, Gemora Global exports worldwide via air freight (DHL/FedEx/UPS) to over 30 countries.
- **Q: Where is Gemora Global located?**
  - **A**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India — the premier global manufacturing hub for Indian imitation and Kundan jewellery.
- **Q: Are the products anti-tarnish and safe?**
  - **A**: Yes, all jewellery features anti-tarnish protective lacquer coatings and is 100% lead-free, nickel-free, and hypoallergenic.
